initial_report_excerpt: around 8 seconds it should be Em, it goes Am, Em, Am, Em in the intro

screenshot_transcription.limit: Screenshot chord order only; no recording identity or verified timestamps supplied.

sources.title: Jon MacLennan: The ULTIMATE House of the Rising Sun Guitar Lesson
observations: The intro lesson gives Am, C, D, F followed by Am, E, Am, E.
It describes an eight-bar intro with one chord per bar and a 6/8 practice count.
The E instruction uses an ordinary E-major open shape rather than Em.

sources.title: Jonathan Richter: House of the Rising Sun by The Animals
observations: The intro chart gives Am, C, D, F followed by Am, E, Am, E.
The teacher setup has no capo and uses E major, with E7 described as an optional organ-inspired addition.
The picking discussion describes 6/8, separately from a simple strumming option.

source_recheck.interpretation: Two primary teacher pages corroborate the founder-confirmed E-major intro order. Their order and bar counts are teaching evidence, not a timestamped reference for this cached recording.
